            {
            XP += (XP * 1.2);
            counter++;
            }

[1/3/2020 11:35 AM] a2152225
I changed the way it calculates the amount of xp needed for each level, originally, it was doing a loop, saying:
xp = 100
counter  = 0; 
While counter < level 
XP = XP x 1.2
counter= counter +1
end loop


[1/3/2020 11:35 AM] a2152225
So, each time it went to check xp, it would run through that setup


[1/3/2020 11:36 AM] a2152225
And enter the loop, and keep processing it for a number of times based on their level


[1/3/2020 11:36 AM] a2152225
so, NOW I changed it to use an exponent instead


[1/3/2020 11:38 AM] a2152225
XP = (100 * Math.Pow(1.2,from.LvL));


[1/3/2020 11:38 AM] a2152225
Math.Pow is the same as  :   1.2^(lvl)


[1/3/2020 11:39 AM] a2152225
its how you call power of


[1/3/2020 11:39 AM] a2152225
in the code


[1/3/2020 11:39 AM] a2152225
So normally on paper it would be    100*(1.2^(player level))


[1/3/2020 11:41 AM] a2152225
Ya, probably boring you with the math talk


[1/3/2020 11:42 AM] a2152225
But, the main point is, this is more efficient -  when you have  200 people all killing things at the same time, or gathering or crafting --  more efficiency helps

[4/15/2020 2:14 PM] a2152225

The most recent save in a 6 hour time block will always have the name of the final hour of that time block.

[10/10/2020 6:24 PM] a2152225
So, I'm thinking someything like this instead for Armor and Weapons at least:
Normal crafting requirements:  Base Crafted item  || Or supplied item
2x Base Crafted Item and Gold Deposit =  Base Item +1  (lets call it 'Final Result')
Final result + 1x Base Item +1 +  Gold deposit =  Base Item +2 
Final result + 2x Base Item +2 + Gold Deposit = Base Item +3 
Final result + 2x Base Item +3 + Gold deposit = Base Item +4 
Final result + 2x Base Item +4 + Gold deposit = Base Item +5
Final result + 2x Base Item +5 + Gold deposit  + Rare Resource = Base Item +6 
Final result + 2x Base Item +6 + Gold deposit  + 2x Rare Resource = Base Item +7
Final result + 2x Base Item +7 + Gold deposit  + 3x Rare Resource = Base Item +8
Final result + 2x Base Item +8 + Gold deposit  + 4x Rare Resource = Base Item +9
Final result + 2x Base Item +9 + Gold deposit  + 5x Rare Resource = Base Item +10
Final result + 2x Base Item +10 + Gold deposit  + 6x Rare Resource = Base Item +11

All stat upgrades will be based on the base item that was first selected


[10/10/2020 6:25 PM] a2152225
In the case of Each 2x, 3x   ---- It means, Starting item will be the base, and you will need 1 or 2 additional items of the same tier to upgrade, its stats


[10/10/2020 6:34 PM] a2152225
Started with a Katana,    you will need 2 Katanas, and a gold deposit to make the starting Katana a  'Katana +1'   
You will then need a 2nd 'Katana +1' to merge into the first one,   totaling 4 Katanas  and gold deposits to make a 'Katana +2' 
Then, you will need that Katana+2, and 2 more Katana +2s   (so 8 more)   total of 12 -  for that 'Katana +3'

[12/20/2020 6:48 PM] a2152225
There are a range of abilities that Jagex Moderators possess. They can:

General
Use the tools that Player Moderators and Forum Moderators have to moderate the game and the forums, as well as being able to issue bans. They also have these abilities on other games and services owned by Jagex.
In-game
Use the rotten potato, an in-game item that has multiple uses, including healing to full, accessing the bank, and sending bots to Botany Bay.
Turn invisible.
Add or remove items from their inventory. Any items dropped aren't visible to other players.
Modify their skills, including their combat level.
Teleport to any location by holding CTRL and clicking on the minimap. Alternatively, they can double click a location on the world map.
Use the developer console in order to change many variables associated with their in-game account, such as quest progress and completion. It can also be used to teleport to players, prevent automatic logout, among other commands.
Transform into any NPC.
Pass, walk on and teleport over physical boundaries (no-clip).
Make themselves vulnerable or invulnerable to all forms of attack.
Kick/ban players from a friends chat or clan chat that doesn't belong to them.
Access member areas while playing in a free-to-play world.
Spawn NPCs in any location.
Wear the Jagex Moderator outfit.
View chat messages that are no longer visible in the chatbox.
Start a Jagex Moderator Event and give out event cards. They can run community scenarios using the pickled cabbage, and access the JMod Toolbox interface.
Use world 13, a server only JMods can see and access

[12/31/2020 7:23 PM] a2152225
Commands from Ultima Live Map streaming used for making changes to a map


[12/31/2020 7:23 PM] a2152225
These are the commands that can be used with the map streaming feature, so changes you make can update to other peoples screens

[DelStatic  - Delete a static 
[addStatic   Usage = "[addStatic itemId Hue [altitude]" 
[MoveStatic - moves a static 
[SetLandID - Set the ID value of a land tile 
[SetLandAlt -  Set the Z altitude of a land tile 
[SetStaticHue  - Set the hue value of a static. 
[SetStaticID - Set the ID value of a static.  
[SetStaticAlt - Set the Z value of a static.  
[IncStaticAlt - Increases the Z value of a static   
[IncSY - Increases Y value of a static  
[IncSX - Increases X value of a static
[GetBlockNumber -  Returns the current block number (aka, what block or chunk of the map you are at, used for next command) 
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[updateblock - Sends Update statics & terrain Packet to the client. - < this is how you say, ok, push these changes for others to see
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++


[12/31/2020 7:24 PM] a2152225

Unlike normal Champs,  it's also only 1 creature type at a time


[7/19/2021 7:24 PM] a2152225
On the altar you will find a number of red and white Skull Candles.
The red candles are an indicator of how big the spawn is and how close you are to summoning the Champion, the more candles there is the closer you are.
The white candles are an indicator of how close you are to getting another red candle.
The more red candles there is on the altar, the more powerful are the creatures that are spawning.
There can be a total of 16 red candles on the altar (16 levels of the spawn) and 5 white candles (you will never see the 5th because it will actually spawn a new red one). Once all 16 red and 5 white candles are there, then the Champion will spawn and all the candles will disappear.
To get more red candles on the altar you need to kill enough monsters within a 10 minute timeframe, the number of monsters depends on the difficulty of the monsters. As you kill monsters, you will see the white candles appear on the shrine. Each of these represents 20% of the necessary monsters having been killed (1 white candle means 20% have been killed, 2 means 40%, etc.).
If you get to 100% of the monsters killed, the spawn level moves forward to the next level, another red candle appears, all the white ones disappear and a new 10 minute timer starts for the next level. If you fail to get 100%, it will either restart the process at the same level, or if you fail miserably, it will move you backward one level and you lose a red candle.
Around level 2 you would have to kill about 250 of the spawning monsters within 10 minutes to progress to the next level.


[7/19/2021 7:30 PM] a2152225
..


Tier 1 will be red candles 1-5, Tier 2 will be red candles 6-9, Tier 3 will be red candles 10-13 and Tier 4 will be red candles 14-16

[7/19/2021 7:55 PM] a2152225
From Left to Right: 
Count | Max | Per | Sub | Reset | To | Kills | minD | MaxD | Rng | RK | Clr | Next Spawn


[7/19/2021 7:58 PM] a2152225
Count is how many are Currently spawned. 
Max is How many TO spawn at once (most that can be out at a time) 
Per is how many to spawn at a time. 
Sub is like Order -  starting with 0
Reset -  in minutes how long do I have to clear the wave or kill enough
To -  If I fail to kill them in time - what Sub/order do I go to next 
Kills - How Many kills are needed to clear the stage
MinD- 
MaxD- 
Rng- 
RK - Require KIlls
Clr - Clear (do I have to kill all the remaining left overs to advance)

How do vpn.s work?


[8/23/2021 8:37 PM] a2152225
The idea behind VPN (virtual private network) is that you connect to a service, and it routes All of your traffic to it, so from your computer, to their service, THEN to wherrever you want


[8/23/2021 8:37 PM] danella1732
are they safe?


[8/23/2021 10:48 PM] a2152225

[8/24/2021 6:29 PM] a2152225
So, more info on that for ya


[8/24/2021 6:29 PM] a2152225
All of your traffic gets directed to one place, and then they send out everywhere else


[8/24/2021 6:30 PM] a2152225
they often claim to not keep logs of where you go, so that companies cannot track you down (not all of them go this route, some do keep logs) -


[8/24/2021 6:30 PM] a2152225
Additionally, your IP when you go to places, will be based on the location that is tunneling all of your stuff


[8/24/2021 6:31 PM] a2152225
So, for example- your IP Address on Relive if you log in, would not be your normal IP


[8/24/2021 6:31 PM] a2152225
This also how people get around things like IP Bans


[8/24/2021 6:31 PM] a2152225
For your usage though, I don't think a vpn is all that useful -- unless you are trying to hide your activity online


[8/24/2021 6:32 PM] a2152225
I have a vpn, because I do things that I need to occasionally not have logged


[8/24/2021 6:48 PM] danella1732
But is it a randomized ip everytime, or the same vpn?


[8/24/2021 8:11 PM] a2152225
depends  on how its set up


[8/24/2021 8:11 PM] a2152225
rarely is it 'randomized'   they don't spoof the IP address, you connect to their server, and they send the requests out


[8/24/2021 8:12 PM] a2152225
now there can be different locations you can be connected through, whcih can change the IP


[8/24/2021 8:12 PM] a2152225
but if you always connect to the same server, you will likely keep getting the same IP

I need to figure out how much an increase for each Rank up


[12/18/2021 12:45 AM] a2152225
and if its Linear, or exponential


[12/18/2021 12:46 AM] a2152225
to rephrase the above :  Linear --  if it goes up by the same amount each time 
exponential - if the amount it increases by gets bigger each rank up


[12/18/2021 12:49 AM] a2152225
examples:
Linear:   Min and max damage, +3  per rank up, always   % hit chance, increase by 15% per rank 
Exponential: Rank 0 to 1:   min and max damage by 1, % hit chance by 5%   -- Rank 1 to 2:  Min and max by 2, % hit chance by 10,  rank 2 to 3:  min an dmax by 3, % chance by 15, rank 3 to 4: min and max by 4 , % chance 20 -  rank 4 to 5: min/max 6, % 25

[2/4/2022 9:24 AM] a2152225
These are the commands that can be used with the map streaming feature, so changes you make can update to other peoples screens

[DelStatic  - Delete a static 
[addStatic   Usage = "[addStatic itemId Hue [altitude]" 
[MoveStatic - moves a static 
[SetLandID - Set the ID value of a land tile 
[SetLandAlt -  Set the Z altitude of a land tile 
[SetStaticHue  - Set the hue value of a static. 
[SetStaticID - Set the ID value of a static.  
[SetStaticAlt - Set the Z value of a static.  
[IncStaticAlt - Increases the Z value of a static   
[IncSY - Increases Y value of a static  
[IncSX - Increases X value of a static
[GetBlockNumber -  Returns the current block number (aka, what block or chunk of the map you are at, used for next command) 
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[updateblock - Sends Update statics & terrain Packet to the client. - < this is how you say, ok, push these changes for others to see
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

In the case of Each 2x, 3x   ---- It means, Starting item will be the base, and you will need 1 or 2 additional items of the same tier to upgrade, its stats

A2 — 10/10/2020
Started with a Katana,    you will need 2 Katanas, and a gold deposit to make the starting Katana a  'Katana +1'
You will then need a 2nd 'Katana +1' to merge into the first one,   totaling 4 Katanas  and gold deposits to make a 'Katana +2'

[6:35 PM]

[6:35 PM]
and 108 Katanas to make a Katana +5
[6:36 PM]

[6:37 PM]
972 Katanas, and 5 total rare resources to make a +7
[6:37 PM]
2916 Katanas, 18 Rare Resources, and all the gold you've farmed up till this point to get your +8
[6:39 PM]
8748 Katanas, 58 Rare resources, a lot more gold   for the +9
[6:39 PM]
26, 244 Katanas, 179 Rare resources,  tons of gold , to make a  +10

•send that sends the object back to the spawner location

[11/20/2024 5:47 PM] a2152225
Symptoms
If blood sugar levels become too low, hypoglycemia signs and symptoms can include:

Looking pale
Shakiness
Sweating
Headache
Hunger or nausea
An irregular or fast heartbeat
Fatigue
Irritability or anxiety
Difficulty concentrating
Dizziness or lightheadedness
Tingling or numbness of the lips, tongue or cheek

As hypoglycemia worsens, signs and symptoms can include:

Confusion, unusual behavior or both, such as the inability to complete routine tasks
Loss of coordination
Slurred speech
Blurry vision or tunnel vision
Nightmares, if asleep

--------------------------------------------

Improper balance of electrolytes can also cause issues with feeling dizzy

really it connects based on the ip, so like  142.251.32.110  if you put that in browser it will take you to Google still


[3/20/2025 1:46 PM] a2152225
the name aspect of sites are managed by something called DNS or domain name server,  when a computer doesn't know that google.com means 142.251.32.110 then it talks to a dns saying,  hey i want to go here,  what's the address


[3/20/2025 1:48 PM] a2152225
the flush command just says,  forget    what ip names are mapped to, So the next time you visit,  it asks the dns for the address again.   to save time,  systems cache or store these details locally once they get then si they don't have to ask the dns each  time you visit


[3/20/2025 1:49 PM] a2152225
the commands only clears out the local storage of mapping,  so you can get updated value from dns when you try to connect again


[3/20/2025 1:51 PM] a2152225
the only negative impact is maybe an extra second for a page to start loading while it gets the values Again,  and just the first time,  it will store it again after


[3/20/2025 1:51 PM] a2152225
it's a very common command used in troubleshooting connectivity

-----------------
this is part of why I've been considering it:
ModernUO, while also a fork of RunUO like ServUO, focuses on implementing technological improvements to enhance performance and potentially support older eras more accurately. Here are some key benefits: 
Faster and More Accurate Timers: ModernUO utilizes a "timer wheel" system, resulting in significantly faster and more accurate timers. This eliminates the need for an additional thread for timer management, which can lead to improved server performance.
Faster World Saves: ModernUO implements a new threaded save system that can save world files considerably faster than older RunUO versions. One user claims world saves are about 30x faster due to a multithreaded parallel approach.
Faster Networking: ModernUO uses fixed Circular Buffers and directly writes packets to the network buffer, leading to a significant increase in networking speed.
Optimized Memory Usage: While ModernUO loads client files differently (loading everything initially), it generally uses considerably less memory than ServUO in the long run.
Improved Random Number Generator: ModernUO uses Xoshiro256++ which provides better accuracy and performance compared to the older RNG used in other emulators.
IPv6 Support: ModernUO supports IPv6.
Cross-Platform Compatibility: ModernUO is designed to run natively on Linux, Windows, or Mac and supports x64/arm64 architecture.
Serialization Optimization: ModernUO can use source generators for serialization/deserialization, allowing it to only serialize changed data. This can drastically speed up world saves, especially on busy servers

[8/3/2025 3:12 PM] a2152225
Here's a more detailed breakdown:
During the Foreclosure Process:
You have the right to stay in your home until the foreclosure process is complete. 
After the Foreclosure Sale:
In Wisconsin, you typically have the right to stay until the property is sold at a sheriff's sale. After the sale, the new owner can seek eviction. 
Redemption Period:
Wisconsin law allows for redemption periods, usually 6-12 months, before the property is sold at a foreclosure sale, allowing you time to potentially work with the lender to keep the home. 
Eviction:
If the new owner seeks eviction after the sale, you will receive a notice to vacate, often with at least 24 hours' notice, but this can vary.

[8/31/2025 4:44 PM] a2152225
Current Useless Skills
Begging
Allows the collection of (very small amounts of) gold, and also some items (which are nearly identical to those that can be purchased from NPC vendors for tuppence). (Note: This one is half useless and half useful since Mondain's Legacy expansion. See Past Useless Skills below.)
Camping
Allows you (and those nearby you) to log out instantly in areas where your character would otherwise remain for a couple of minutes. Cannot be used in certain areas (such as champion spawn zones), requires consumable resources, and is all but made completely redundant by the Hiding skill, player houses and inns.
Forensic Evaluation
Allows you to determine who produced a given corpse. Pointless in that the poor soul who belongs to it can simply be resurrected then asked directly; assuming you have any interest in the matter.
Allows you to determine who's a member of the Thieves Guild. Pointless in that thievery from other players can only be performed in Felucca; an area where it is generally considered acceptable to kill anyone who invades your personal space regardless of their intentions.
Allows you to determine who picked a given chest. Pointless in that players do not need to lock containers due to the House Security system.
Taste Identification
Used to identify potions. Pointless in that potions are usually labeled with their contents regardless of your skill level, and can be determined by colour if not.
Can detect poison in foods. Pointless in that the Create Food spell is a ready source of uncontaminated goods, and characters do not currently need to eat.

The Camping skill improves a player’s carrying capacity for items and weight. Players can use a Dagger on trees to create kindling, which can then be used to make a campfire. After a short duration, a player's campsite will become 'secure'. Near a secure campfire players can perform 'Hiking' to fast travel to a vast array of locations in an Atlas. Players can also use a Bedroll near a secure campfire instantly log out from most locations (excluding dungeons).

[8/31/2025 4:57 PM] a2152225
Character weight is fixed at 14 stones.
Maximum weight is determined by multiplying Strength by 3.5 and adding 100 ( 40 for elves* ).
Carry Capacity is determined by subtracting Body Weight (14) from Maximum Weight.
Backpack maximum capacity is 550 stones for both races.
I'll just need to make sure i make adjustments as well to the backpack carry weight
